reviews.text: Lori made inhome visits to our mini poodles on multiple occasions with a great experience everytime. She was flexible and understanding to our needs and of our dogs.

We would use Lori when we were on vacation or taking a  day trip. Our border collie Zoe was really good with her. She would come over twice a day to feed her, make sure she had water and take her outside to play. I never worried because I knew that Zoe was being cared for. I appreciate all she did for Zoe.
Lori has been taking care of my dogs for years and they love her.  She makes sure they have all the care they need and is very affordable.   Highly recommend!!!

Lori watched my dogs for many years and if not for moving she would still be watching them.  She is reliable, thorough, available, and very good with dogs.  I never had a single issue and she was never unable to accommodate even last minute requests for pet-sitting.  I highly recommend her and wish she lived closer to me!
Lori has been taking care of our dogs for years.  She is always available, very reliable, and my dogs love her.  I highly recommend her services.

Lori has been dog sitting our two dachshunds for years now, and she is fantastic. I never worry when we go out of town if our pets are okay because I know Lori is watching them. I could not recommend her more highly.
We have used Abbeys Affordable Pet Nanny service for over 10 years.  I couldn't recommend a better pet nanny.  She is very reliable and goes above and beyond.  I highly recommend this service!
